title: 4 cup coffee maker
text:
4 cup coffee maker. Was looking for a one person brew pot - I drink 1-2 cups of coffee per day and personally prefer a drip brew. For the price, this one is just about perfect. The filter basket detaches easily for cleaning and when in use, it "swings" to the side - as illustrated on the ad page. It
s a little wonky and rinky dink. It might last a year or two with daily use. Reality check... this is PLASTIC - all except the tiny glass carafe. It's not going to be a legacy piece of kitchen equipment - but - the price is right! I ran some water through it as I always do first... completed the water run quickly within a few minutes... no alarm to tell you it's done. Nor does it have an "auto off" feature. It's ghetto man. A simple on and off switch. Nothing much to malfunction. The water was reasonably hot when the cycle was complete and it stayed hot. It says "4" cups... but it's really like 2 mugs OR possibly 4 if you use a small teacup for your morning joe. :) Also to note.. .there is a "reusable" cone shaped filter in the basket...I still use a paper liner for ease of cleaning - the small round filters (4 cup version) do fit.. the #2 cone shaped paper filter works too... The pot as a whole takes up very little space as it is a small pot. About 4" wide x 6" deep (eye ballin it). Honestly, I was just happy to pay a few bucks and get something that works. I don't require fancy. :) Having said that... I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful - right now it's a 5 star satisfaction rating -and I hope this info was useful to you in your decision process as that is really the only reason I bother to write my 100% uncompensated reviews! Happy bargain hunting!

product_metadata.title: Elite Cuisine EHC-2022 4 Cup Coffee Maker with Pause and Serve, Black
features: Semi-transparent water reservoir holds up to 4 cup capacity with water level indicator
4 cup glass coffee carafe is dishwasher safe
Pause 'N Serve function and On/Off switch
Swing out filter compartment with re-usable and washable built-in filter
description: Start your day off right with the Elite Cuisine 4-Cup Coffeemaker. Its compact design is great for home, school or office. Brews up to 4 cups of coffee and has a conveniently marked carafe and water reservoir. Features a built-in Pause ‘N Serve system that allows you to sneak a cup of coffee while still brewing. The built-in removable and washable filter saves money and eliminates waste from disposable filters and makes clean-up a cinch. Also has an On/Off switch and power indicator light.
